facts.text: Scenes from the video game Postal 2 appear in the music video for The Black Eyed Peas single "Where Is the Love?"
facts.source_quote: Scenes of the game can be seen in the music video of The Black Eyed Peas single "Where Is the Love?"

facts.text: "Where Is the Love?" was released in June 2003 as the lead single from The Black Eyed Peas' third album, "Elephunk."
facts.source_quote: It was released in June 2003 as the lead single from their third album, "Elephunk".

relations.text: The song whose music video features scenes from Postal 2 is the same song, "Where Is the Love?," that was released in June 2003.
